title: Course Readiness Checklist
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting course readiness checklist to capstone defense evidence board with limitations and transfer claims, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze how the capstone defense evidence board with limitations and transfer claims shows a defensible decision in AIL 606.
